nullable_inout_capacity_ptr.description: pointer parameter used as an in/out capacity slot; must be null-checked before dereference

capacity_computer.description: function that computes a new capacity from the current capacity value

deref_read.description: read through the capacity pointer, e.g., *capacity

deref_write.description: write through the capacity pointer, e.g., *capacity = newSize

null_guard.description: early-return null check, e.g., if (capacity == NULL) return NULL;

null_on_failure.description: condition indicating failure, e.g., realloc returning NULL or capacity computer returning negative
